macros.doc: To produce a business card, you should issue the macro \BusinessCard.

macros.name: CardGap
macros.doc: With \CardGap you can set the default gap between cards.

macros.name: CurrentIC
macros.doc: When used inside a card, the macro \CurrentIC prints the number of the current index/flash card, and \TotalIC prints the total of cards stored in the stack.

macros.name: CurrentIC*
macros.doc: When used inside a card, the macro \CurrentIC prints the number of the current index/flash card, and \TotalIC prints the total of cards stored in the stack.

macros.name: FlashCard
macros.doc: The package provides the alias \FlashCard for your convenience when writing flash cards but it is the same as \IndexCard.

macros.name: FlashCard
macros.doc: The package provides the alias \FlashCard for your convenience when writing flash cards but it is the same as \IndexCard.

macros.name: IndexCard
macros.doc: This command has the same syntax of \BusinessCard but it manages a stack of index/flash cards.

macros.name: IndexCard
